provenance: Rampart rebuilds opened an assault root's shoulders into weapon blocks and replaced vulnerable cockpit glazing with a heavy forward mantlet. Halloran's named survivors are hired for work expected to damage them.
serviceHistory: A Rampart contract begins with the road survey. Gates may have to come down before the machine reaches the gate it was hired to break, and a narrow turn can delay the entire job. Halloran keeps those costs separate from the daily hire. Customers who dispute them are invited to propose another route.

Crews attach considerable importance to the people following with the recovery equipment. The armament can make a breach; it cannot guarantee that the machine will walk back out of it. A successful Rampart assignment often ends with the employer holding the ground while a fitter works under the mantlet.
fieldNotes: The low forward slab and large weapon blocks mark a committed breaching machine. Its stock weapons cover different distances, so having a target in reach does not mean the whole battery can answer. Plan the approach and the recovery. The frame is slow to correct a mistake in either.
